about: Prince Edward County is a single-tier municipality in eastern Ontario, a nearly island-like peninsula in Lake Ontario south of Belleville. Despite its official city status, it feels like a rural county of farms, beaches, and small towns—Picton, Wellington, Bloomfield, and others—famous for wine, sand dunes, and summer tourism. About 26,000 people live in Prince Edward County.
